name: The Shield of Achilles — Full 5-Fold Concentric Worldtext (Iliad 18.478–608)
greek: Πρῶτα μὲν σάκος ποίει μέγα τε στιβαρόν τε πάντοσε δαιδάλλων... ἐν δ᾽ ἐτίθει ποταμοῖο μέγα σθένος Ὠκεανοῖο ἄντυγα πὰρ πυμάτην σάκεος πύκα ποιητοῖο.
buckley: First of all he formed a shield, both large and solid, adorning it all over; and around it he threw a shining border, triple, glittering; and from it suspended a silver belt. Five were the folds of the shield itself... And in it he placed the vast strength of the river Oceanus, around the extreme border of the well-formed shield.

worldModel.vision: 84×84 stud concentric 5-fold LEGO disk uniting all five Homeric metals (Gold 297, Silver 179, Bronze 28/84, Tin 71, Kyanos 272/33) from the Cosmic Omphalos to the Oceanus Rim.
worldModel.memory: Simultaneous multi-ring state machine: polar rotation of the Bear, legal turn-taking in the Sacred Circle, river ambush escalation, golden glebe turning black behind the plough, dogs oscillating before the lions, and the Daedalean wheel/row dance.
worldModel.controller: Operative Worldtext (Bolter & Hartsoe): the viewer/warrior navigates from macro-cosmos to micro-scene, probing the rules, memory, and consequences of mortal life.

shots.name: Macro-Cosmos: The Five-Fold Shield
shots.beat: Hephaestus forges a world out of bronze, tin, gold, silver, and dark-blue kyanos: Cosmos at center, Oceanus at rim, human society organized between.

shots.name: Fold 1 & 2: The Cosmic Boss & The Two Cities
shots.beat: Around the tireless Sun, Full Moon, and unbathing Bear stand the Two Cities: the Torchlit Wedding & Sacred Circle of Law vs. the Siege of Golden Ares & Pallas Athena.

shots.name: Fold 3: Ploughing, Silent King’s Harvest & Golden Vineyard
shots.beat: In the middle ring the golden fallow turns marvelously black behind the plough, the King rejoices in silence over the harvest, and the Linus song rings through the kyanos-trenched vineyard.

shots.name: Fold 4 & 5: Cattle & Lions, Daedalean Choros & River Oceanus
shots.beat: Two lions seize the bull while nine dogs dart back; Knossian youths and maidens whirl like a potter’s wheel; and the mighty River Oceanus encloses the uttermost rim.
